extDescription.message: Fill in and save passwords from the SecureVault password manager on this computer.

pairStep2.message: Check that the program shows the same code as here.

pairWaiting.message: Waiting for your answer in the program…

pairDoneText.message: This browser is connected to SecureVault. You can close this tab.

pairExpired.message: The program did not answer in time.
